name: copysync-extension
description: Extensão Chrome MV3 — sincroniza a sessão de afiliado do Mercado Livre com o painel

scripts.build: node ./node_modules/webpack/bin/webpack.js --progress --config webpack.js --stats-error-details --mode production --env envFile=.env && node scripts/check-dist.mjs
scripts.build:store: node ./node_modules/webpack/bin/webpack.js --progress --config webpack.js --stats-error-details --mode production --env envFile=.env --env store=true && node scripts/check-dist.mjs
scripts.type-check: tsc --noEmit && node scripts/check-cookie-scope.mjs && node scripts/check-i18n.mjs && node scripts/check-contract-sync.mjs
